bosch-identity-audit:
Usage: smlt bosch-identity-audit INPUT.csv --channel-metadata LABELS.json (--stdout | --output NEW.json)

Offline BOSCH v1 identity inventory and exact channel-name audit.

Original standard-library software. No network, NetCDF library, scientific
numeric decoder, imputation, row exclusion, feature extraction or model fitting.


--stdout explicitly prints raw identity/coordinate metadata.
--output creates a new report, never overwrites a path or symlink.
See docs/reference/bosch-identity-audit.md for complete input schema and limits.

Windows builds are cross-compiled; Windows runtime is not yet validated.
hall-response:
usage: smlt hall-response [-h] --field-unit {T,mT,uT,G,kG} --voltage-unit
                          {V,mV,uV,nV} --current-unit {A,mA,uA,nA,pA}
                          --accept-hall-assumptions
                          (--output OUTPUT | --stdout) [--version]
                          input

Describe signed transverse voltage versus B within separate fixed-current Hall
branches; no carrier-property inference.

positional arguments:
  input                 UTF-8 CSV with exactly lot,wafer,device,condition,repl
                        icate,branch,temperature_K,bias_current,magnetic_field
                        ,transverse_voltage

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --field-unit {T,mT,uT,G,kG}
                        Magnetic flux density B, not magnetic field strength H
  --voltage-unit {V,mV,uV,nV}
  --current-unit {A,mA,uA,nA,pA}
  --accept-hall-assumptions
                        Declare documented signed terminals/field axis, fixed
                        current/temperature/protocol and separate monotonic
                        branches; see README
  --output OUTPUT       Create a new POSIX owner-only JSON report; never overwrite
  --stdout              Explicitly print identifiers, observations and fit
                        diagnostics

iv-readpoint:
usage: smlt iv-readpoint [-h] --voltage-unit {V,mV,uV} --current-unit
                         {A,mA,uA,nA,pA} --read-voltage READ_VOLTAGE
                         --read-voltage-unit {V,mV,uV} [--branch BRANCH]
                         [--max-bracket-span MAX_BRACKET_SPAN]
                         (--output OUTPUT | --stdout) [--version]
                         input

Extract signed current and static I/V at a read voltage within each explicit
semiconductor I–V branch. No extrapolation or inferred switching states.

positional arguments:
  input                 UTF-8 CSV with exactly
                        device,cycle,branch,voltage,current

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --voltage-unit {V,mV,uV}
                        Unit of the input voltage column
  --current-unit {A,mA,uA,nA,pA}
                        Unit of the input current column
  --read-voltage READ_VOLTAGE
                        Signed nonzero read voltage (use --read-voltage=-0.1
                        for negatives)
  --read-voltage-unit {V,mV,uV}
                        Unit of read voltage and optional maximum bracket span
  --branch BRANCH       Exact user-declared branch label; otherwise process
                        each branch separately
  --max-bracket-span MAX_BRACKET_SPAN
                        Optional positive bound on interpolation bracket
                        width, in --read-voltage-unit
  --output OUTPUT       Create a new JSON report with POSIX owner-only permissions;
                        never overwrite
  --stdout              Explicitly print raw identifiers, measurements, and
                        derived features to stdout
  --version             show program's version number and exit
